snippet.title: Cirno! Lifts a Boulder Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4173110/Cirno_Lifts_a_Boulder/

Help Cirno get back into her home! A chill, bite-sized 3D platformer and Touhou fangame in which you explore a frozen Misty Lake and gain boulder-lifting strength.

Links, Presskit and more: https://cirnoliftsaboulder.carrd.co/

#touhou #cirno #indiegame
